sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Choose the correct article to complete the sentence: She carried ___ umbrella because it was raining heavily.
Who invented the special reading system for visually impaired people discussed in the chapter 'Braille'?
Identify the subject in this sentence: 'The little brown puppy chased its own tail.'
According to 'Be Smart Be Safe', what is the safest way to cross a busy road?
options: A) Run across as fast as you can
B) Cross only at the zebra crossing while looking both ways
C) Walk behind a moving bus
D) Cross while listening to music
questions.answer: B) Cross only at the zebra crossing while looking both ways

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a collective noun?
What is the core message of the story 'Together We Can'?
options: A) Working alone is the fastest way
B) Teamwork makes difficult tasks much easier
C) Never ask for help from friends
D) Playing games is a waste of time
questions.answer: B) Teamwork makes difficult tasks much easier

questions.question_text: Choose the correct pronoun to complete the sentence: Rohan and I are good friends. ___ play in the park every evening.
Choose the correct verb that agrees with the subject: The dog ___ loudly at the stranger.
In the story 'The Tinkling Bells', what was making the tinkling sound?
options: A) The wind chimes in the window
B) The small bells tied to the animals
C) Coins falling on the floor
questions.answer: B) The small bells tied to the animals

questions.question_text: Identify the helping verb in this sentence: 'She is singing a beautiful song for the audience.'

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: What moral lesson do we learn from the poem 'One Thing at a Time'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The lesson teaches us that we should focus fully on a single task to complete it successfully, rather than doing many things at once and ruining them.

questions.question_text: Change the following statement into an interrogative sentence: 'The children are playing in the garden.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To change this statement into a question, we move the helping verb to the beginning: 'Are the children playing in the garden?'

questions.question_text: Explain briefly how the Braille system helps visually impaired people to read. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Braille uses special patterns of raised dots on thick paper. Visually impaired people read by running their fingertips over these dots to feel the letters.

questions.question_text: Rewrite the following sentence using a possessive noun: 'The bags belonging to the students are heavy.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: To show possession, we add an apostrophe. The correctly rewritten sentence is: 'The students' bags are very heavy to carry around the school.'

questions.question_text: State two important safety rules you must follow when you are at home alone. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: You must never open the front door for unknown strangers, and you should never play with sharp knives or matchsticks to avoid serious accidents.

questions.question_text: In the story 'The Old Stag', why did the stag feel proud of his horns but ashamed of his thin legs? What happened in the end? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The stag admired his beautiful, branching horns but disliked his ugly, thin legs. However, when chased by hunters, his thin legs helped him run fast, while his proud horns got tangled tightly in the thick bushes, trapping him.

questions.question_text: Read this paragraph and rewrite it by replacing the repeated nouns with suitable pronouns: 'Sonia loves reading books. Sonia went to the library to borrow books.' [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Sonia loves reading books. She went to the library to borrow them today. The pronoun 'she' replaces Sonia, and 'them' replaces the books, which helps avoid repeating the exact same nouns over and over again in the paragraph.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Write a short paragraph about a time when you and your friends worked together as a team to complete a project or win a game. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Last month, our class participated in a school cleanliness drive. We divided the work into small groups. Some swept the floor, while others arranged the desks and cleaned the boards. By working together as a strong team, we finished quickly and won the 'Cleanest Classroom' award from our principal.

questions.question_text: Write a formal application to your class teacher requesting permission to sit in the front row because you forgot your reading glasses at home. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Teacher, I am writing to inform you that I accidentally forgot my reading glasses at home today. Because of this, I cannot see the blackboard clearly from the back bench. I kindly request you to allow me to sit in the front row for today. Thanking you, Yours obediently.
